warning.rule2: No warning emails are sent after the project status becomes Won or Lost
warning.rule3: Yellow and red warnings are each sent once (the warning time is recorded in the database)
warning.rule4: Warning emails are sent to the sales manager, cc the sales director
warning.rule5: Warning email templates can be edited on the Report Templates page
